environment.description: Application deployed behind an Istio service mesh with PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode on the namespace. The ingress gateway (envoy-based) is configured with a DestinationRule that specifies tls.mode=ISTIO_MUTUAL for the backend service. Additionally, the external-facing Gateway resource references a credentialName pointing to a Kubernetes secret containing a CA bundle (internal-client-ca) used for client certificate validation. The Gateway spec.servers[].tls.mode is set to MUTUAL, requiring connecting clients to present a certificate signed by the internal CA. Browser-originated requests (including CSRF attack pages hosted on attacker domains) cannot present valid client certificates signed by the internal CA, as the private keys are distributed only via MDM-enrolled corporate devices using SCEP enrollment profiles. The Istio gateway returns a 403 with 'client certificate required' before any HTTP payload reaches the application pod.

config.client_cert_distribution: MDM/SCEP enrollment on corporate devices only
config.gateway_rejection_behavior: TLS handshake failure before HTTP processing
